sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_profiles" ("slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "base_currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("slot"), CHECK (slot = 1), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (base_currency_code IN ('HKD','USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','THB','CNY')), CHECK (created_at_utc <= updated_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), CHECK (kind IN ('cash','bank','creditCard','eWallet','other')), CHECK (currency_code IN ('HKD','USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','THB','CNY')), CHECK (opening_minor_units >= -9223372036854775807), CHECK (length(opening_date) = 10), CHECK (created_at_utc <= updated_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), CHECK (kind IN ('income','expense')), CHECK (created_at_utc <= updated_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), CHECK (description IS NULL OR length(description) <= 500), CHECK (created_at_utc <= updated_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "warning_threshold_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 80, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), CHECK (amount_minor_units >= 0), CHECK (currency_code IN ('HKD','USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','THB','CNY')), CHECK (length(month) = 7 AND substr(month, 5, 1) = '-'), CHECK (warning_threshold_percent BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (created_at_utc <= updated_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookkeeping_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (kind IN ('income','expense')), CHECK (amount_minor_units > 0), CHECK (length(business_date) = 10), CHECK (created_at_utc <= updated_at_utc), CHECK (deleted_at_utc IS NULL OR deleted_at_utc >= created_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id), "source_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "destination_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "source_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_minor_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "destination_currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (source_account_id <> destination_account_id), CHECK (source_minor_units > 0 AND destination_minor_units > 0), CHECK (source_currency_code IN ('HKD','USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','THB','CNY')), CHECK (destination_currency_code IN ('HKD','USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','THB','CNY')), CHECK (source_currency_code <> destination_currency_code OR source_minor_units = destination_minor_units), CHECK (length(business_date) = 10), CHECK (created_at_utc <= updated_at_utc), CHECK (deleted_at_utc IS NULL OR deleted_at_utc >= created_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES local_profiles (id), "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_transactions (id), "storage_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (length(storage_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), CHECK (mime_type IN ('image/jpeg')), CHECK (byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760), CHECK (length(sha256_hex) = 64), CHECK (position BETWEEN 0 AND 4));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_link_states" ("slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cloud_account_id" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unlinked', "sync_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("sync_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "needs_reconciliation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_reconciliation" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("slot"), CHECK (slot = 1), CHECK (state IN ('unlinked','linked','needsReconciliation')), CHECK (cloud_account_id IS NULL OR length(cloud_account_id) = 36));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_device_states" ("slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("slot"), CHECK (slot = 1), CHECK (length(device_id) = 36));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_applied_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("slot"), CHECK (slot = 1), CHECK (last_applied_sequence >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_entity_states" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_type", "entity_id"), CHECK (server_version >= 1), CHECK (server_revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("queue_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_server_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_attempt_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "next_attempt_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "last_failure_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK (length(mutation_id) = 36), CHECK (operation IN ('create','update','delete')), CHECK (base_server_version IS NULL OR base_server_version >= 0), CHECK (state IN ('pending','processing','blocked')), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mutation_id" TEXT NULL, "base_server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remote_server_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remote_server_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_candidate_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_candidate_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "detected_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unresolved', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(id) = 36), CHECK (base_server_version >= 0), CHECK (remote_server_version >= 1), CHECK (remote_server_revision >= 1), CHECK (status IN ('unresolved','resolved')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_receipt_spool_entries" ("attachment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("attachment_id"), CHECK (length(attachment_id) = 36), CHECK (length(storage_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), CHECK (length(sha256_hex) = 64), CHECK (byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_attachment_cleanup" ("storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("storage_path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_onboarding_state" ("slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dataset_generation" TEXT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle', "initialization_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "last_successful_sync_at_utc" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("slot"), CHECK (slot = 1), CHECK (dataset_generation IS NULL OR length(dataset_generation) = 36), CHECK (initialization_operation_id IS NULL OR length(initialization_operation_id) = 36), CHECK (stage IN ('idle','discovering','localToCloud','cloudToLocal','reconciling','active','failed')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_initialization_entities" ("ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("entity_type", "entity_id"), CHECK (length(entity_id) = 36));
CREATE INDEX history_profile_date_id ON bookkeeping_transactions (profile_id, business_date, id)
CREATE INDEX transfer_profile_date_id ON transfers (profile_id, business_date, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX receipt_transaction_position ON receipt_attachments (transaction_id, position)
CREATE INDEX sync_outbox_queue ON sync_outbox (queue_sequence)
CREATE INDEX sync_outbox_entity_queue ON sync_outbox (entity_type, entity_id, queue_sequence)
